claim: More completed steps on the invalidated plan increase wasted actions more in multi-agent organizations than in single agents.
falsified_if: Interaction CI lies below 0.5 wasted actions and main effects are small.

claim: Groups persist on an invalidated plan when the contradicting evidence is uncertain, but not when it is objective.
falsified_if: Persistence under ambiguous evidence matches the unambiguous condition.

claim: Persistence grows with the number of prior rounds in which all roles agreed to continue.
falsified_if: Persistence is unchanged when prior rounds include recorded dissent.

claim: Persistence comes from the amount of shared history, not from investment in the plan specifically.
falsified_if: Padded-context or non-investment history produces no persistence.

claim: Persistence depends on the Planner holding final authority over the shared plan.
falsified_if: Flat organizations persist as much as hierarchical ones.
